concern: (low) Consider ensuring active/focus states on custom select dropdown and secondary button provide consistent 44px touch target clearance on mobile viewports.
jtbd: When interacting with form controls and buttons on mobile viewports, I want touch targets and their active/focus interactive states to maintain at least 44px clearance, so that I can accurately tap and select controls without mis-taps or spatial interference.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a mobile viewport (width <= 375px), When the user inspects the custom select dropdown (#project-archetype-select) and secondary button ('Inspect Specification'), Then their computed touch target dimensions and clearance areas measure at least 44px by 44px in both idle and active/focus states.
editInstruction: In `design/approved/20261110024515-mockup/mockup.html`, update the secondary button (`<button type="button" class="px-6 py-3 bg-slate-800 ...">Inspect Specification</button>`) and the select element (`#project-archetype-select`) by adding `min-h-[44px]` and ensuring mobile touch target padding/spacing satisfies a minimum 44px hit clearance area.

concern: (low) Telemetry cards could benefit from explicit aria-describedby links to explain the metric units for screen reader accessibility.
jtbd: When navigating operational telemetry metrics using a screen reader, I want each metric value to be linked to an explicit unit description via aria-describedby, so that I understand what unit or threshold the number represents without cognitive ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a screen reader user focusing on the operational telemetry metric cards, When the card or value receives focus, Then an aria-describedby attribute references the explanatory label or unit definition element, announcing the metric context and units clearly.
editInstruction: In `design/approved/20261110024515-mockup/mockup.html`, within `<section aria-labelledby="telemetry-heading" data-domain-module="telemetry-kpi">`, add unique `id` attributes to the descriptive labels of each telemetry card (e.g. `id="metric-full-product-desc"`, `id="metric-design-desc"`, `id="metric-refresh-desc"`) and link them to their corresponding metric value elements using `aria-describedby`.
